subject: maths
question: Mahesh and Suresh can complete a work in 16 days and 12 days, respectively. Starting with Mahesh, they work on alternate basis. How many days will take to finalise the complete work?
solution:
**Given:**

Mahesh can complete the work in 16 days

Suresh can complete the work in 12 days

They work on the alternative basis

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Time taken x Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work = LCM of 16 and 12 = 48 

⇒ Efficiency of Mahesh = Total work / Time taken = 48 / 16 = 3

⇒ Efficiency of Suresh = Total work / Time taken = 48 / 12 = 4

⇒ The total efficiency of both = 7 

We can say that,

⇒ In 2 days = 7 work is completed

⇒ 12 days = 42 work

For 13 days Mahesh has to work 

⇒ 13 days = 42 + 3 = 45 work

The remaining work has to complete by Suresh

⇒ Remaining work = 48 - 45 = 3

⇒ The remaining work is completed in = 3 / 4 days

⇒ Total days to complete the work = 13 + 3/4 = 13(3)/(4)

**Hence, The total work is completed in 13(3)/(4)** **days**
